subject: Trial pathway and PoC stitch plan — deployment-mode options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)
messages:
From: Ava Lawson <ava.lawson@solihealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@solihealth.com
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 15:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — deployment constraints & next steps

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move the PoC planning forward: we need to validate two things for SoliHealth before we commit to a deployment path:

1) Data residency & compliance: all PHI processing needs to remain in the US region and we need to validate audit logs/KMS integration (HIPAA).
2) Performance: our goal is ~100 req/s sustained for batched inference with p95 latency under 200ms for short prompts (<= 512 tokens).

We are open to starting with a Hosted sandbox if that lets us validate ML behavior quickly, but the procurement and security teams are pushing for a Dedicated reserved pool or Private VPC evaluation because of isolation and audit requirements.

Can you: (a) propose a concrete PoC plan that compares Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (what we can validate in 2–4 weeks), (b) list success criteria and decision gates, and (c) outline the stakeholders and timeline you’ll need from us?

I attached the RFP summary we pulled together. Procurement copied here will want a rough cost estimate for a 4-week trial.

Thanks — happy to discuss over a short sync if helpful.

—Ava

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 17:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Trial plan & deployment-mode comparison

Hi Ava —

Appreciate the clear summary — outlined below is a concise PoC (trial) plan that compares the three deployment modes and gives you concrete pass/fail gates so procurement and engineering can decide quickly. This is intentionally prescriptive so you can share it with stakeholders.

PoC objective: validate model behavior, latency/throughput, and compliance controls to decide between Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or Private VPC.

High-level timeline (4 weeks typical):
- Week 0: Kickoff & security intake (security questionnaire + access).
- Week 1: Integration & smoke tests (Hosted sandbox + Dedicated staging); baseline ML quality checks.
- Week 2: Load run (Dedicated pool) + region/residency validation. Private VPC dry-run (networking checklist) runs in parallel with lower traffic.
- Week 3: Regression checks, billing/throughput reporting, audit log review, and follow-on exec demo.
- Week 4: Decision review and recommended next steps.

Success criteria (pass if all of the below met):
- Functional: model responses meet agreed QA pass rate on your prompt set (we’ll run 500 prompts from your sample set; target >= 92% acceptance).
- Perf: p95 latency <= 220ms on Dedicated under 75–100 req/s sustained (we can tune batching to meet this).
- Security: KMS integration verified, access logs present in the console, SOC2 evidence shared (or Private VPC networking checklist completed).
- Ops: per-token cost estimate for expected 1M tokens/month usage under Dedicated vs Hosted provided.

Mode-specific validation:
- Hosted sandbox: fastest path to validate model behavior and sample prompts. Limited for compliance (demo only, not for PHI).
- Dedicated capacity: can meet perf and isolation needs; we’ll run the main load test here.
- Private VPC: full compliance posture (networking + KMS) — needs more lead time for networking and procurement.

Stakeholders we’ll need from SoliHealth:
- Technical lead (integration): to provide sample prompts and access for test accounts.
- Security lead: for the intake questionnaire and to review audit logs/KMS plan.
- Procurement: to review trial terms and cost commitment if we move to Dedicated.

Attachments I’m including: PoC charter template you can use to accept the plan, and a rough cost estimate for a 4-week Dedicated trial (very high level).

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm preferred initial mode to validate (Hosted sandbox vs Dedicated). Based on your compliance comment I recommend we run parallel Hosted (behavior) + Dedicated (load) and schedule a Private VPC dry-run if security clears it.
2) Kickoff: propose Apr 20 for a 60-minute kickoff (we’ll include Solutions and Infra).
3) I’ll send the security questionnaire and a detailed week-by-week playbook once we confirm kickoff.

Happy to hop on a 20–30m call Friday if you want to walk through this with procurement.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Trial plan & deployment-mode comparison — quick notes on perf/cost

Looping in a couple of quick engineering notes and an internal ask:

- For the Dedicated load run: we should baseline with two instance shapes (A100-80GB equivalent and a smaller T4-like quantized instance) to show cost/latency tradeoffs. I’ll prepare a short table for your procurement.
- Memo on batching: to meet p95 <=220ms at 75–100 req/s we’ll likely need continuous batching with a 40–60ms scheduling window; token budgets and prompt length distribution will change that — can you share the 95th-percentile prompt length?
- KV/prefix caching: if you have repeated system prompts or shared context, caching could materially reduce token spend; would be good to know if prompts share prefixes.

Internal ask: Monica — can you pick this up as the Solutions lead and own the integration runbook (networking checklist, test accounts, and the post-run cost report)?

Neha/Ava — I’ll draft a 1-page comparison of Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC with ballpark PoC spend estimates by EOD Monday.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Hi Neha/Marcus/Monica —

Thanks — this is very helpful and exactly the level we need. After internal alignment procurement + security prefer we run a two-track PoC:

1) Primary: Dedicated trial (4 weeks) to validate perf, cost, and operational observability.
2) Secondary: Private VPC dry-run (networking + KMS checklist) during week 2–3 to confirm we can meet PHI/audit requirements — full VPC rollout would be a later step post-contract.

We can run Hosted sandbox only for quick ML behavior checks but it won’t count toward compliance validation.

Kickoff: Apr 20 at 16:00 PT works for us. Please include SRE (Ben Hollis) and Security (Riya Patel) from our side — I’ll have procurement send the PO contact card in a follow-up (attached).

Procurement note: we’ve budgeted for a short Dedicated trial; need your rough cost estimate to complete the PO.

I’ll confirm the prompt-set export and 95th-percentile prompt length by Monday EOD.

Thanks — looking forward to the plan and the Monday cost note.
